subject.title: feat(durable): add beta3 runtime core foundation

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this durable runtime as the canonical cross-owner recovery substrate, and if so should it replace or integrate with the existing task, subagent, audit, lease, flow, and delivery state owners?
rationale: The PR establishes a new persistent runtime, protocol, CLI, environment controls, and lifecycle semantics; functional review cannot safely choose that permanent architecture without maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor and consolidate
options.body: Approve the durable direction but require idempotency correctness, one shared-state migration owner, Kysely runtime access, narrower scope, and full live upgrade proof.

options.title: Extend existing owners
options.body: Reject the parallel runtime ledger and add missing recovery facts to the existing task, subagent, audit, lease, flow, and delivery stores.

options.title: Pause for cumulative review
options.body: Hold this PR until the RFC and dependent slices are available for end-to-end architecture and behavior review.

recommendation.title: Sponsor and consolidate
recommendation.body: Approve the durable direction but require idempotency correctness, one shared-state migration owner, Kysely runtime access, narrower scope, and full live upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The canonical shared-state database and the heaviest affected gateway and subagent history route to this owner candidate.
